preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of characters that can be removed from the string s.
